subject: FinEdge security gate: MAP milestone assignments & SOC 2 evidence cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@finedge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:22:00Z
Subject: Quick recap + proposed MAP items from today

Priyanka — great talk today, thanks for walking through FinEdge's integration priorities. Per our call I promised a very short, focused Mutual Action Plan (MAP) slice for the security milestone so your procurement and IT teams can see owners and dates.

Key items I captured:
- Security questionnaire (you to provide current version) — target intake: 2026-08-10
- SOC 2 evidence bundle (Redwood to deliver SOC 2 summary + list of evidence we will provide) — target delivery: 2026-08-12
- Security review meeting (Redwood security + FinEdge IT) — proposed: 2026-08-11 14:00 ET

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm the questionnaire file we should use (you mentioned a spreadsheet template)
2) Please share a single point of contact for evidence intake (name + email) so our security lead can coordinate uploads to your portal/Drive

I'll attach a MAP draft with those milestones and owners; think of this as the working slice we can iterate on. I'll also attach our SOC 2 one-pager so your team has a compact view of scope and dates.

Next steps I will take this week:
- Ben: update MAP with explicit owners and dependencies and share by EOD 8/5
- Soojin (security): prepare SOC 2 evidence list and note any gaps we'll need FinEdge to fill

Attachments: MAP-draft-FinEdge-20260804.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP-draft-FinEdge-20260804.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]
[attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 56KB)]

From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@finedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Rivera <marco.rivera@finedge.com>, security@finedge.com
Date: 2026-08-05T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed MAP items from today

Thanks Ben — this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side before you finalize the MAP slice: 

- Questionnaire: attaching our standard vendor security checklist (we call it "FE Vendor Sec Q1"). If you can map answers to the columns, that helps our audit team.
- Evidence intake point: Marco Rivera (marco.rivera@finedge.com) will own uploads; he prefers a single zipped package or direct Drive permissions.
- SOC 2: our audit team wants a short evidence index (filename -> control mapping) in addition to the certificate/summary.

We can do the security review meeting on 8/11 14:00 ET — Marco and one of our auditors (TBD) will join.

Attaching: FE_Vendor_Sec_Q1.xlsx (we expect you to complete the highlighted columns).

Priyanka
Head of IT Risk
FinEdge
[attachment: FE_Vendor_Sec_Q1.xlsx (xlsx, 76KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@finedge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T18:47:00Z
Subject: MAP draft v2 (owners, dependencies) + evidence index template

Priyanka / Marco — seen your questionnaire, thanks. I've attached MAP-draft-FinEdge-20260804.xlsx (v2) with explicit owners and a short dependency column. Summary of changes: 

- Security questionnaire intake: owner Marco Rivera (FinEdge) / Ben Carter (Redwood) — due 2026-08-10
- SOC 2 summary + evidence index (Redwood) — owner: Soojin Lee — due 2026-08-12. Deliverables: SOC2 certificate (pdf), control-evidence-index.xlsx, sample artifact list (logs/configs)
- Security review meeting: scheduled 2026-08-11 14:00 ET (invites sent) — main agenda: evidence handoff & outstanding gaps

Dependencies called out:
- Access to your secure Drive or SFTP for evidence upload (Marco to confirm)
- Confirmation of which control families FinEdge needs mapped (e.g., CC1, CC2; Marco to advise)

I've also attached an evidence-index template (first tab of the MAP file). Soojin — can you confirm which artifacts we can produce by 8/12 and flag anything that needs engineering support? I'll collect the list and propose a handoff format (zip vs Drive share).

Attachments: MAP-draft-FinEdge-20260804.xlsx (v2), FinEdge_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (copied), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — Ben
[attachment: MAP-draft-FinEdge-20260804.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)]
[attachment: FinEdge_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 76KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka@finedge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft v2 (owners, dependencies) + evidence index template

Hi all — quick update from Security (short and actionable):

1) Evidence we can provide by 2026-08-12 (deliverables):
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- Control evidence index (control-evidence-index.xlsx) — will follow as attachment by EOD 8/12
- Sample artifacts: config snapshot (scrubbed), example access logs (7 days), change-control tickets list (IDs)

2) Items that need FinEdge action before handoff:
- Drive access: Marco please confirm upload method (Drive permissions preferred). We need a folder entitled /FinEdge/FE-2026-042/evidence
- Control mapping: Priyanka — confirm whether you need SOC 2 CC mapping or a subset (e.g., only CC1-CC3)

3) Security review meeting on 8/11: I'll present the evidence index template and proposed handoff process (zip vs Drive). If possible, please give our engineering team short-lived read-only access to the target Drive location so we can drop artifacts directly.

Quoted for context:
> On Thu, Aug 6, 2026 at 6:47 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I've also attached an evidence-index template (first tab of the MAP file). Soojin — can you confirm which artifacts we can produce by 8/12 and flag anything that needs engineering support?
>
Thanks — Soojin
